shared_elements: bird-like or long-necked animal forms in profile
repeated geometric patterning or border motifs
justification: The main overlap is that both surfaces use schematic profile animal figures together with geometric patterning and horizontal division into zones. The biggest difference is that B is organized around a framed, register-like scene with prominent standing human figures above large animals, whereas A is dominated by scattered animal and sign-like motifs without the same human group or enclosed narrative composition.
